items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5：性能接近 Fable 5，价格仅为其一半  Anthropic 正式推出 Claude Opus 5。
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5：性能接近旗舰，价格减半
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5: Near-Flagship Performance at Half Price
items.summary: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, delivering near-flagship performance at half the cost, becoming the default for Claude Max and strongest on Pro.

items.title: Mojo 1.0
items.title_zh: Mojo 1.0 正式发布，Python 兼容高性能 AI 语言
items.title_en: Mojo 1.0 Released, Python-Compatible Language for AI
items.summary: Mojo 1.0, a Python-compatible language for high-performance AI/ML, is officially released, though it faces community skepticism over its closed-source compiler.

items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.title_zh: 从专有LLM API窃取隐藏的思维链推理痕迹
items.title_en: Stealing Hidden Chain-of-Thought Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: A method to extract hidden chain-of-thought reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs is presented, raising questions about model transparency and ethical boundaries.

items.title: Nvidia's Risky Business
items.title_zh: 英伟达的冒险生意：软件护城河与需求风险
items.title_en: Nvidia's Risky Business: Software Moat and Demand Risks
items.summary: An insightful Stratechery analysis examining the risks in Nvidia's AI dominance, with community debate on software moats and demand growth assumptions.

items.title: H3-metal – Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: H3-metal：在苹果芯片上原生运行 MiniMax-H3 推理
items.title_en: H3-metal: Native MiniMax-H3 Inference for Apple Silicon
items.summary: A native implementation for running MiniMax-H3 inference on Apple Silicon, highly relevant to ML engineers and creators, with strong community engagement on hardware constraints and optimizations.

items.title: London Underground begins scanning passengers' faces
items.title_zh: 伦敦地铁试点面部识别扫描
items.title_en: London Underground Begins Live Facial Recognition Scanning Trial
items.summary: London Underground begins a trial of live facial recognition scanning at stations, sparking significant debate over privacy and civil liberties.

items.title: Introducing Muse Glimmer
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Glimmer：一个 30B 开源权重智能体模型
items.title_en: Meta Launches Muse Glimmer, a 30B Open-Weight Agentic Model
items.summary: Meta introduces Muse Glimmer, a 30B Apache 2.0 licensed model focused on agentic task completion and reliable tool use.

items.title: Decoupled Descent: Enforcing Exact Train-Test Error Tracking Via AMP Onsager Corrections [R]
items.title_zh: 解耦下降：利用AMP Onsager修正追踪测试误差的新训练方法
items.title_en: Decoupled Descent: New Training Method Tracks Test Error via AMP
items.summary: The author introduces Decoupled Descent, a training method that leverages AMP Onsager corrections to enforce asymptotic equality between train and test error in neural networks.

items.title: HyperSAE: Decoupled Poincaré Geometry for Sparse Autoencoders -- 9.8% MSE reduction, 0.2% dead latents on Gemma-2-2B [P]
items.title_zh: HyperSAE：将解耦庞加莱几何用于稀疏自编码器，均方误差降低9.8%
items.title_en: HyperSAE applies decoupled Poincaré geometry to sparse autoencoders, cutting MSE by 9.8%
items.summary: HyperSAE introduces a decoupled Poincaré geometry for sparse autoencoders, reducing reconstruction error and dead latents on Gemma-2-2B while maintaining zero inference overhead.

items.title: 📱 Meta 切断与 Manus 数据共享，推进收购案拆分  Meta 已从本月起切断与中国 AI 公司 Manus 的数据联系，禁止后者访问其内部系统，Met
items.title_zh: Meta 切断与 Manus 数据共享，推进 20 亿美元收购案拆分
items.title_en: Meta cuts data sharing with Manus as $2B acquisition unravels
items.summary: Meta has cut data sharing with Chinese AI company Manus to comply with a regulatory order to unwind its $2 billion acquisition deal.
